note: Both sets contain essentially the same 22 claims: the same correct extractions (HabEx 4 m / 4 instruments / 52 m starshade, LUVOIR-A 15 m on-axis / 4, LUVOIR-B 8 m off-axis / 3, Lynx 3 m mirror assembly / 10 m focal length / 3, Origins 5.9 m / 3) and the same defects. The only wording differences are trivial: A says 'Lynx | focal length | 10 m' where B says 'Lynx mirror assembly | focal length | 10 m' (both acceptable, B marginally more precise), and instrument-count claims are named 'science instrument count' vs 'instrument count'. Both make the same misbindings (10 m called a dimension/diameter of the mirror assembly when it is the focal length; the three instruments attributed to the mirror assembly rather than Lynx) and the same line-break fragment entities ('n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope', 'spacecraft'), plus a duplicated starshade claim.
remarks: Both sets share identical defects, suggesting a common upstream extraction bug: bullet text split across line breaks produced fragment entities ('n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope', 'spacecraft') and the Lynx sentence's '10 m focal length' was re-bound as a dimension/diameter of the mirror assembly. The HabEx starshade 52 m claim is duplicated in both sets. One quote is garbled ('with a 10 m nd three science instruments') and another uses an ellipsis ('Lynx: ... and three science instruments'); both sets do this identically.
